blockers.secure_context: You opened Orqevio over an unencrypted connection (http://). Browsers only allow the vault’s encryption on secure connections: open your copy over https:// (for example, behind Caddy, Nginx, or Traefik) or, on the same computer, at http://localhost.
blockers.webcrypto: This browser doesn’t offer WebCrypto, which the vault uses to encrypt your data.
blockers.workers: This browser doesn’t support Web Workers, which the vault uses to derive your key without freezing the page.
blockers.webassembly: This browser doesn’t support WebAssembly, which the vault uses to derive your key with Argon2id.

unsupported.updateBrowser: Use a current version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
unsupported.restWorks: Your tasks and documents keep working as usual.

toolbar.generatorDescription: Unbiased cryptographic randomness from your browser.

list.label: Vault items
list.footer_one: {{count}} item · decrypted only in this browser
list.footer_other: {{count}} items · decrypted only in this browser

empty.body: Everything is encrypted in your browser before it’s sent to the server. Neither the server nor your agents can read it.

delete.title: Delete “{{title}}”?
delete.description: It will be permanently deleted from your vault.

detail.passwordCopied: Password copied · the clipboard clears in 30 s
detail.clipboardClears: When you copy something, the clipboard clears itself after 30 seconds.

editor.name: Name
editor.totpHint: The key the service shows you next to the QR code when you turn on two-step verification.

changeMaster.title: Change master password
changeMaster.description: Your items aren’t encrypted again: only the vault key is protected with the new password. Your recovery key stays valid.
changeMaster.wrongCurrent: The current master password isn’t correct.

strength.emptyHint: Use at least 12 characters. A phrase of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
strength.fairHint: Add more words or a wider mix of characters.
strength.rememberHint: Remember: if you forget it, only the recovery key can open the vault.

generator.copied: Copied · the clipboard clears in 30 s

guarantees.agents: Agents and MCP have no access

gate.decryptFailed_one: {{count}} item couldn’t be decrypted and was skipped.
gate.decryptFailed_other: {{count}} items couldn’t be decrypted and were skipped.

setup.title: Set up your vault
setup.subtitle: Choose a master password. It’s used in your browser to encrypt your secrets and is never sent to the server.
setup.failed: Couldn’t create the vault in this browser.
setup.ready: Your vault is ready. Only you can open it.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.subtitle: It’s the only way to recover the vault if you forget your master password. It’s shown only once.
recoveryKey.fileText:
Orqevio — Vault recovery key

{{recoveryKey}}

Keep it outside Orqevio (for example, printed or in another password manager).
It lets you reset the master password. No one else can recover it for you.
recoveryKey.saved: I’ve saved it somewhere safe, outside Orqevio.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.subtitle: Enter your master password to decrypt your logins in this browser.

recover.title: Recover the vault
recover.subtitle: Use the recovery key you saved when you created the vault to choose a new master password.

reset.title: Reset the vault
reset.description: Without the master password or the recovery key, no one can decrypt your data, not even us. Resetting permanently deletes every item.
reset.accessKeyHint: Confirm it’s you with this copy’s access key (not the master password).
reset.done: Vault reset. You can set it up again.

import.title: Import into the vault
import.description: The file is read and encrypted in this browser: the server only receives items that are already encrypted.
import.formats: Supports the CSV that Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari export, Bitwarden’s CSV and unencrypted JSON, and encrypted Orqevio exports.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large (over {{size}} MB).

problems.unknown_format: Orqevio doesn’t recognize this file. Use the CSV that Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari export, Bitwarden’s CSV or JSON, or an Orqevio export.
problems.bitwarden_encrypted: This is an encrypted Bitwarden export. Export it again as unencrypted “.json” or “.csv” and import it here.
problems.no_items: The file has no logins or notes.

import.encrypted_one: This is an encrypted Orqevio export with {{count}} item. Enter the master password you had when you exported it.
import.encrypted_other: This is an encrypted Orqevio export with {{count}} items. Enter the master password you had when you exported it.
import.wrongPassword: That’s not the password this export was made with.
import.duplicates_one: {{count}} item is already in your vault and will be skipped
import.duplicates_other: {{count}} items are already in your vault and will be skipped
import.unsupported_one: {{count}} item isn’t supported (cards or identities) and won’t be imported
import.unsupported_other: {{count}} items aren’t supported (cards or identities) and won’t be imported
import.unencryptedWarning: The file you chose isn’t encrypted: delete it from your computer when you’re done.
import.failed_one: {{count}} item couldn’t be imported. Import the file again: items already imported will be skipped.
import.failed_other: {{count}} items couldn’t be imported. Import the file again: items already imported will be skipped.
import.locked: The vault locked before the import finished. Unlock it and import the file again: anything already imported will be skipped.

export.title: Export the vault
export.description: Download all your items as a file, prepared in this browser.
export.encryptedInfo: Only your current master password opens it. Use it as a backup or to move your items to another copy of Orqevio.
export.plainInfo: In Bitwarden’s JSON format, which most password managers can import. Anyone who has the file can read it.
export.understood: I understand the file isn’t encrypted and that anyone who has it can read all my passwords.
export.tooLarge: The export is larger than {{size}} MB: Orqevio won’t be able to import it.
